title: Time and Deadlines
description: The party under more time pressure makes more concessions. Real deadlines concentrate minds; fake deadlines lose power fast.

sections.title: What It Is
sections.content: The party under more time pressure makes more concessions. Real deadlines concentrate minds; fake deadlines lose power fast.

sections.title: How It Actually Appears
content: 'This offer expires Friday at 5 PM.' The counterpart scrambles to decide.
A quarterly sales quota is imminent; the salesperson suddenly offers discounts they refused last month.
A contractor delays quote delivery to pressure you into a quick decision when it arrives.

sections.title: Warning Signs You Are Being Time-Pressured
content: Sudden urgency after weeks of calm.
'We need an answer today' with no logical reason.
The deadline coincides with their internal cycle (month-end, quarter-end).

sections.title: Protection Strategy
content: Always question the deadline: 'What happens if we need until Monday?'
Create a buffer. If you know a deadline is coming, front-load your preparation so you aren't rushed.
Never make a major concession purely because the clock is ticking.

sections.title: Key Insight
sections.content: Deadlines are often illusions. Test them gently, and you'll often find they dissolve.
